title: The Ashoka Chakra
body: The Ashoka Chakra appears at the centre of India's national flag. It is drawn as a wheel: a circular rim with 24 identical spokes that meet at the centre of the wheel. The spokes are spaced equally all the way around, so the angle between any two neighbouring spokes is the same. Farhan's class is studying the chakra to find its symmetries. Farhan traces the wheel on tracing paper, pins the tracing at the centre, and slowly turns it to see when the tracing fits exactly over the picture again. His friend Kavya folds a paper copy of the wheel along different lines through the centre to see when the two halves overlap.
